confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nha Trang price levels, brought forward to the July 2026 peak season with allowance for local price growth and an assumed broadly stable dong exchange rate. No live menus, listings or booking pages were checked, and no web sources were used for city prices. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation is less certain because July rates vary widely by location and room type. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local draft-beer relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX observation comes from one web search summary of the RBA exchange-rate table, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Vietnamese coastal resort cities with similar tourist demand, such as Da Nang and Phan Thiet, used as loose reference points and adjusted to Nha Trang's own price level. Accommodation reflects July peak-season demand. Cocktail and wine_glass use the local draft-beer relationship as their basis.
